units.source_text: 听她这么一说，倒好像真是这么个理儿。

en.t: Hearing her put it that way, it did seem as if there really was some sense to it.

units.source_text: 星星像团团烟雾，说明风已经没有力量去吹散天空中的水蒸气了。

en.t: The stars looked like clouds of smoke, which meant the wind no longer had the strength to scatter the water vapor in the sky.

units.source_text: 今晚像是不会有什么大风啦……

en.t: It looked as though there would be no strong wind tonight...

units.source_text: 所以，村里那帮家伙们的结论也不会心急慌忙地提出吧……

en.t: So those people in the village probably would not rush to deliver their decision either...

units.source_text: 原以为她的话是没头没脑的蠢话，但意外地发现倒也是顺理成章的回答。

en.t: He had thought her words were senseless nonsense, but unexpectedly found that they were actually a perfectly logical answer.
